sections.heading: Our commitment
sections.body: DevFest Chennai is committed to providing a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation. We do not tolerate harassment of event participants in any form, at the venue or in any associated online spaces.

sections.heading: Expected behaviour
sections.body: Be respectful and considerate in speech and actions. Refrain from demeaning, discriminatory, or harassing behaviour and speech. Alert organisers if you notice a dangerous situation, someone in distress, or violations of this code of conduct, even if they seem inconsequential.

sections.heading: Unacceptable behaviour
sections.body: Harassment includes offensive comments related to any protected characteristic, sexual images in public spaces, deliberate intimidation, stalking, sustained disruption of talks, and unwelcome sexual attention.

sections.heading: Reporting
sections.body: If you are being harassed, notice that someone else is being harassed, or have any other concerns, please contact a member of the organising team immediately.
